scope: ZL_SERVER and FILES_SERVER recovered source only

method.description: Parsed the recovered JavaScript with Babel. Identified base64 string arrays, decoder offsets, decoder aliases, and arithmetic rotation checks. Evaluated only a whitelist of literal arithmetic and base64 decoding in the analysis utility. Did not execute recovered source, require recovered modules, contact providers, or mutate original source.
method.references: Controller originals are one line. References below use the derived readable copy with a header mapping it to recovered/<same path>; these are analysis copies, not replacement source.
method.limitations: Static findings identify code behavior; live Zalo/OA validity, delivery, real database types/constraints, Telegram configuration, and production network boundaries were not verified. The parent task owns runtime verification.

artifacts.schema_prerequisite: Apply analysis/main-schema-inferred.sql first. This is a synthetic local compatibility schema, not an original dump or a production migration.

architecture.zalo_worker: Express internal worker; explicit ZL_SERVER_HOST/ZL_SERVER_PORT; loads recovered/.env with override=true. Every route including /health passes IP/key middleware. /zalo/* also requires userID from body/query and sets req.user using parseInt. Database test must succeed before app.listen.
architecture.files_worker: Express image upload/serving and hit collector; FILES_SERVER_PORT; host and DB host selected from DOCKER_HOST, ignoring DB_HOST. false => loopback/127.0.0.1; true => 0.0.0.0/host.docker.internal. Requires database connection before listen. Contains no authentication middleware.
architecture.tracking_flow: V2/card send inserts auto_request, sends an image URL with ?req=<reqID>, records send result, and charges successful sends. FILES records visits for numeric req into auto_request.Detail; BC* req into oa_result.detail; ?id takes precedence and writes link_results_thumbnail.results. Each hit is also appended to image-server-logs.txt and may trigger Telegram.
architecture.important_limit: An image fetch records the connecting client/proxy, which can be a Zalo preview/proxy rather than the recipient. It does not by itself establish that the recipient opened the image or reveal an exact physical location.

dependencies_and_env.startup_blocker_order: First mounted zaloAccountRoutes requires zaloAccountController, which immediately requires crypto-js. checkIpController later requires cheerio. Dormant missing local middleware do not block the active ZL entrypoint.

findings.title: Internal key middleware fails open when INTERNAL_AUTH_KEY is absent
findings.detail: An absent header and absent environment value compare equal (undefined === undefined). Loopback requests then pass without an auth key. zl_server sets trust proxy to 1; req.ip can be influenced by forwarded headers on an exposed listener. Binding to loopback and configuring a nonempty key are necessary boundaries.

findings.title: Unauthenticated file read can escape files directory
findings.detail: POST /remote-server accepts requestPath/targetImageFile from JSON. serveImageFile strips leading slashes then path.join resolves parent segments; there is no root-containment validation. An existing escaped path is read and streamed. The basename fallback does not protect the first candidate. Exposure increases when DOCKER_HOST=true binds 0.0.0.0.

findings.title: Unauthenticated uploads use unsanitized caller-controlled filenames
findings.detail: Thumbnail diskStorage returns req.body.custom_filename directly. The normal image filename interpolates x-user-id. Both accept path separators/parent components before Multer joins filename to destination, allowing writes beyond intended directories. Existing files can be overwritten. Image validation trusts declared MIME OR extension; SVG is accepted for thumbnails without content checks.

findings.title: Zalo credentials leak through intended masking helper
findings.detail: Account create/update logs spread maskSensitiveData({IMEI, ENCRYPTION_KEY, COOKIE_ZPW_SEK}), but sensitiveKeys contains none of those exact names. Actual keys/cookies are therefore logged unchanged. They also remain plaintext database fields.

findings.title: OA credentials and state have no user or role scoping
findings.detail: Any caller passing worker boundary checks and any truthy userID can read latest global access/refresh token, rotate it, edit/delete global templates and enumerate all OA results. getToken returns the entire database record. The MAIN proxy must enforce an explicit role policy for these routes; the worker does not.

findings.title: String licenseType can charge money while creating zero-use license
findings.detail: Input passes parseInt-based validation and price selection, but countDown uses strict comparisons of the original value against numeric 1/2/3. JSON/form string values produce countDown=0, then the code inserts the license and deducts the price. countDown is also assigned as an undeclared global.

findings.title: Fee arithmetic can concatenate DECIMAL strings
findings.detail: V2/card fee is read directly from tool_setup and custom-image surcharge uses += 5000 without numeric conversion. mysql2 returns DECIMAL as strings by default; a configured decimal string then concatenates rather than adds. The both-IP multiplication later coerces the concatenated value. checkStatus correctly uses parseFloat, demonstrating inconsistency. Original DB types were not supplied.

findings.title: External sends and image hits race the uncommitted tracking transaction
findings.detail: V2/card hold a user wallet row lock and create PENDING tracking rows inside one transaction, call Zalo, optionally delete message, and commit only at the end. A fast image fetch sees no committed reqID and is discarded by FILES. A later SQL failure can roll back logs/fee despite an already-sent message; a user retry may send again. No idempotency key/outbox is present.

findings.title: Tracking attributes are forgeable and HTML is stored unescaped
findings.detail: FILES trusts Cloudflare/True-Client-IP/X-Forwarded-For headers without validating proxy origin; /remote-server accepts all tracking values in the body. Unescaped user agent/IP/time are concatenated into HTML Detail/detail and Telegram HTML. This can falsify collected evidence, break Telegram formatting, and create stored-HTML/XSS risk if the frontend renders the strings as HTML.

findings.title: Concurrent hit updates can overwrite each other and notifications are unbounded
findings.detail: handleTracking reads the current detail/results then replaces it with current+new. Concurrent readers can discard each other's appended blocks. There is no hit deduplication/rate limit/log rotation, including on nonexistent requested files; each request may write DB/log and trigger Telegram before file existence is checked.

findings.title: Async connection acquisition bypasses request error handlers
findings.detail: V2/card send await db.getConnection before entering try. Rejection is not caught by those handlers, and Express 4 does not automatically route async rejection to the final error middleware. Request failure may leave a hung response or terminate the process under unhandled-rejection behavior.

findings.title: Legacy image send bypasses V2 billing and uses inconsistent result vocabulary
findings.detail: The active legacy POST /zalo/send-image accepts arbitrary imageUrl and first linked account, with no wallet check or fee deduction. It stores THÀNH CÔNG/XẢY RA LỖI while its stats query counts SUCCESS/FAILED/ERROR. Legacy history and fee statistics therefore disagree; using this path bypasses the V2 paid workflow.

findings.title: OA order generation and token replacement are non-atomic
findings.detail: order_code uses COUNT(oa_result)+1, so simultaneous sends or deletions can reuse BC order codes and associate later hits incorrectly. Token refresh executes DELETE FROM zalo_token then INSERT without a transaction, creating an empty-token window and losing the old token if insertion fails. Concurrent refresh-token rotation is also unsynchronized.

findings.title: Previews expose paid lookup data without charging and confirmation is replayable
findings.detail: check-status pre-check returns profile before wallet charging; confirmation accepts arbitrary targetUserId and performs no binding to the preview. V2 search/card decode also return target profile data before payment. Image-send confirmation trusts caller-supplied resolved target/display name. If lookup data is intended to be paid, the current protocol does not enforce that policy; it also lacks replay/idempotency tokens.

findings.title: Mounted worker routes do not implement advertised rate limits or CSRF
findings.detail: V2/card route comments advertise 10/minute and 5/minute plus CSRF, but only controller functions are mounted. checkIp has an actual limiter. Public exposure and MAIN's middleware determine practical impact; source comments alone are not evidence of protections.

findings.title: Input and configuration validation is incomplete
findings.detail: trustMiddleware accepts parseInt partial strings/NaN. History page/limit are not fully clamped and can produce invalid SQL offsets. IP regex accepts octets greater than 255 and loosely formed IPv6. Empty/missing IMG_URL breaks string operations or yields unusable URL. Custom image substitution assumes configured filename qc.png. ZL startup log names DB_USER_ZL although connection uses DB_USER_ZL_SERVER.

findings.title: Missing environment values and read-stream errors can stop FILES
findings.detail: DOCKER_HOST.trim() throws during module initialization if unset. path.join(..., IMAGE_FILE) throws after database connection if FILES_SERVER_IMAGE_FILE is undefined. serveImageFile checks existence but does not attach an error handler to fs.createReadStream, so a directory/unreadable file or a file disappearing after access can emit an unhandled error. No health route is defined.

findings.title: Dormant logs controller assumes wrong db.query return shape
findings.detail: getAllLogs, getSystemStats, searchLogs destructure [rows] from db.query although the wrapper already returns rows. Lists become the first row and count reads dereference another nonexistent array level. Missing middleware/apiLogger blocks loading this dormant module first.

findings.title: Dormant product statistics use inconsistent license columns
findings.detail: getProductStats counts l.isActivated and sums l.pricePaid, while purchaseLicense writes status/countDown to license and pricePaid to user_link_license. This requires unsupported duplicate schema fields and will not reflect actual sales consistently.

findings.title: Dormant CAPTCHA debug logging reveals plaintext answer
findings.detail: generateCaptcha logs the plaintext answer, hash and session ID even though storage uses an answer hash. Math.random also generates CAPTCHA characters. This module is not mounted by the ZL entrypoint.
